sous_titre: Térawattheures produits dans le monde, 2015, 2022 et 2025

2015.texte: It has grown more than tenfold in the decade since 2015, when global solar generation was just 256 TWh.

2022.texte: Solar has been doubling roughly every three years, rising from 1,333 TWh in 2022.

2025.texte: Solar power increased by a record 636 TWh to reach 2,778 TWh in 2025, a 30% increase from 2024.
